name: SS - Lens Focus
description: Innovative image gallery with cinematic lens focus effect. Images start slightly blurred or desaturated and sharpen on hover or scroll into view. Features a spotlight reveal with adjustable focus radius, grayscale-to-color transitions, smooth zoom on hover, optional lightbox, category filter tabs, and gradient overlays. Each image supports title, subtitle, badge, and link. Choose focus mode: hover, scroll, or always-on. Perfect for photography portfolios, product galleries, creative agencies, and visual storytelling. 85+ customization options.
author: Section Hub
